verdict.rationale: Autumn is a billing and entitlements layer built on Stripe, so issuing refunds is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions full or partial refunds from either the dashboard or the API. The documented billing endpoints cover attach, preview, multi-attach, schedules, import and the customer portal, none of which are refunds.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can issue full or partial refunds from both the dashboard and the API
